blocks.title: DNS and Email Security exam shortcuts
items: Domain should not resolve for users → DNS FILTERING
Block access before the connection is made.
Example: A known malware domain is denied by DNS policy.
Need list of authorized sending mail servers → SPF
SPF tells receivers which servers may send for the domain.
Example: Only Microsoft 365 servers are authorized.
Need signed message integrity/domain proof → DKIM
DKIM adds a cryptographic signature to outgoing mail.
Example: Recipient validates the DKIM signature.
Need policy for SPF/DKIM failures + reports → DMARC
DMARC tells receiving systems whether to monitor, quarantine, or reject failing mail.
Example: Spoofed messages are rejected under a DMARC policy.
Need to scan attachments and phishing messages centrally → EMAIL GATEWAY
Use a secure email gateway as the inspection point.
Example: A malicious attachment is blocked before delivery.
blocks.example: Focus on what needs to be changed: traffic rules, detection logic, protocol choice, filtering policy, endpoint response, or user-behavior controls.

questions.q: A company wants users prevented from resolving known malware domains. Which control should be modified?
questions.explanation: DNS filtering blocks or redirects requests for risky domains.

questions.q: A domain owner wants to specify which mail servers are authorized to send email for the domain. Which control is used?
questions.explanation: SPF publishes authorized sending servers in DNS.

questions.q: Outgoing messages should be cryptographically signed so recipients can verify integrity and domain authorization. Which control is used?
questions.explanation: DKIM adds a cryptographic signature to outgoing email.

questions.q: A company wants receiving mail systems to reject messages that fail email-authentication checks and wants reports on failures. Which control is best?
questions.explanation: DMARC applies policy to SPF/DKIM results and supports reporting.

questions.q: Inbound attachments should be scanned for malware and phishing before reaching users. Which enterprise capability is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: A secure email gateway filters and scans email before delivery.
